mapper.select: SELECT /*LGSYSC00220.retrieveUserMenuList*/ ma.menu_id ,ma.menu_name ,ma.system_code ,ma.module_code ,ma.high_menu_id ,ma.menu_desc ,ma.menu_level_no ,ma.sort_order_no FROM (SELECT lmm.* ,lfs.sort_order_no AS user_sort_order_no ,lookup.sort_order_no AS lookup_sort_order_no FROM lgcom_menu_m_v lmm ,lgcom_full_system_favor_hier_n lfs ,(SELECT lc.common_code ,lc.sort_order_no FROM LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_C lc WHERE lc.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_SYSTEM_CODE') lookup WHERE lmm.menu_id = lfs.menu_id AND lmm.system_code = lookup.common_code AND lmm.display_flag = 'Y' AND lmm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND lfs.application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId, jdbcType=NUMERIC } ) ma START WITH ma.menu_level_no = 1 CONNECT BY PRIOR ma.menu_id = ma.high_menu_id ORDER SIBLINGS BY ma.lookup_sort_order_no, ma.user_sort_order_no, ma.menu_name

SELECT /* LGSYSC00220.retrieveMyMenuListByRole */ DECODE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM LGCOM_FULL_SYSTEM_FAVOR_HIER_N WHERE application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND menu_id = ma.menu_id),1,'Y','N') user_menu_yn , #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS application_user_id , ma.menu_id , ma.menu_name , ma.system_code , ma.module_code , ma.high_menu_id , ma.menu_desc , ma.menu_level_no , ma.sort_order_no , ma.program_id FROM ( SELECT common_code AS menu_id , (SELECT common_code_name FROM LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_MULTI_LANG_C WHERE code_type_code = 'LGCOM_SYSTEM_CODE' AND common_code = lc.common_code AND language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) AS menu_name , common_code AS system_code , NULL AS module_code , NULL AS high_menu_id , NULL AS program_id , NULL AS menu_desc , 0 AS menu_level_no , sort_order_no FROM LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_C lc WHERE code_type_code = 'LGCOM_SYSTEM_CODE' AND use_flag = 'Y' AND NVL(apply_start_date,SYSDATE) < (SYSDATE + 1) AND NVL(apply_end_date, SYSDATE) >= SYSDATE AND EXISTS (SELECT 'x' FROM LGCOM_USER_MENU_INFO_V WHERE system_code = lc.common_code AND application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}) UNION SELECT a.menu_id , a.menu_name , a.system_code , a.module_code , DECODE(a.menu_level_no,1,a.system_code,a.high_menu_id) AS high_menu_id , a.program_id , a.menu_desc , a.menu_level_no , a.sort_order_no FROM LGCOM_USER_MENU_INFO_V a , ( SELECT role_code , org_id , menu_id FROM ( SELECT a.role_code , NULL AS org_id , b.menu_id FROM lgcom_user_role_n a , lgcom_role_menu_n b WHERE a.application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} AND a.role_code = b.role_code AND NVL(apply_start_date,SYSDATE) <= SYSDATE AND NVL(apply_end_date,SYSDATE) >= SYSDATE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT '1' FROM lgcom_role_biz_org_n WHERE organization_type_code = 'C' AND role_code = a.role_code) UNION SELECT a.role_code , b.company_id AS org_id , c.menu_id FROM lgcom_user_role_n a , lgcom_role_biz_org_n b , lgcom_role_menu_n c WHERE a.role_code = b.role_code AND a.role_code = c.role_code AND a.application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} AND NVL(a.apply_start_date,SYSDATE) <= SYSDATE AND NVL(a.apply_end_date,SYSDATE) >= SYSDATE AND b.organization_type_code = 'C' ) WHERE (org_id IS NULL OR org_id = #{USER_SESSION.defaultOrgId}) ) b WHERE a.application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} AND a.menu_id = b.menu_id AND a.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} ) ma WHERE 1 = 1
AND system_code = #{systemCode}
AND (module_code IS NULL OR module_code = #{moduleCode})
AND UPPER(menu_name) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{menuName})||'%'
START WITH ma.menu_level_no = 0 CONNECT BY PRIOR ma.menu_id = ma.high_menu_id ORDER SIBLINGS BY ma.sort_order_no, ma.menu_name

LGCOM_ROLE_BIZ_ORG_N b , LGCOM_ROLE_MENU_N c WHERE a.role_code = b.role_code AND a.role_code = c.role_code AND a.application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} AND = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ) ma START WITH ma.menu_level_no = 0 CONNECT BY PRIOR ma.menu_id = ma.high_menu_id ORDER SIBLINGS BY ma.user_sort_order_no, ma.menu_name
